scope.summary: Implement texture-follows-morph re-projection (spec 13.22; PREQ-026, the stated differentiator): anchor-defined albedo features (areolas, tan lines, decals) re-project to correct positions and scales under drastic proportion change - areolas stay centered on nipple apexes at 300% breast volume, tan-line boundaries follow the new silhouette - with Argus capture pairs proving placement.
acceptance_criteria: Feature-anchored re-projection: designated albedo features (areolas, tan lines, decals) carry anchor definitions (region + landmark refs) and re-project to correct position/scale when proportions change drastically (PREQ-026).
Areola test: at 300% breast volume the areola stays centered on the nipple apex with documented max drift; tan-line boundaries follow the deformed silhouette.
Re-projection triggers on channel-state change past a documented threshold; outputs are deterministic and hash-cached.
Re-projected features are layer transforms in the MT-564 stack - source textures untouched; Argus base-vs-extreme capture pairs persist as visual evidence.
scope.risk_if_missed: Areolas sliding off nipples and tan lines distorting under proportion change is the canonical texture-follows-morph failure that remains unsolved in Daz (PREQ-026); this differentiator is what keeps extreme morphs production-usable rather than demo-only.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
